step1.title: Welcome to Wraith
step1.description: This is Wraith. We're showing private payments on Stellar testnet. Click Connect Wallet to start.

step2.title: Stealth Key Derivation
step2.description: We just asked your wallet to sign a stealth-key derivation message. These keys live in your browser, not on any server.

step3.title: Recipient Address
step3.description: Paste any Stellar stealth meta-address here — or type a .wraith name.

step4.title: Amount
step4.description: Enter an XLM amount. We'll generate a fresh stealth address — the recipient's real address never appears on-chain.

step5.title: Send Privately
step5.description: When you send, the network sees a transfer to a new address that nobody can link to the recipient. Try it on testnet.
